Our story

From court corridors to forever

Our Story

In the busy corridors of the court house, where every face carried a story and every file carried a battle, two souls unknowingly began writing the most beautiful chapter of their own lives.

Harkish and Karthika first met not at a cafe, not at a celebration, but inside court rooms filled with arguments, long hearings, and endless case bundles. Their days were spent fighting for justice, standing strong in black robes, carrying dreams much bigger than themselves.

Amid the noise of legal discussions and hurried footsteps across the court verandas, their eyes slowly began to search for each other.

What started as simple conversations about cases and judgments slowly turned into caring questions about meals, sleepless nights, and tiring days. Somewhere between adjournments and affidavits, between coffee breaks and courtroom smiles, friendship quietly transformed into love.

They never realized when “Did you finish your work?” became “Did you reach home safely?”

Or when waiting outside court halls became waiting for each other.

The courtrooms that once witnessed arguments soon became silent witnesses to a love story built on respect, patience, understanding, and unwavering support. They saw each other not only as advocates, but as companions who could stand beside one another through every victory and every storm.

Today, the same two hearts that once crossed paths in crowded court corridors are preparing to walk hand in hand into a lifetime together.

Their love was never loud.

It was found in shared smiles during stressful days, in comforting glances across courtrooms, in silent prayers for each other’s success, and in the promise that no matter how difficult life became, they would always stand together; just like they always did in court.

And now, as Harkish and Karthika prepare for marriage, their story reminds everyone that sometimes destiny does not arrive with grand announcements.

Sometimes, destiny walks in quietly and becomes your forever.

From the first promise to forever
